subject: general
question: In 2024, the Government of India announced updates to the Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP), aiming to boost self-reliance in defence manufacturing. Which of the following is NOT an intended objective of the updated DAP 2024?

options.text: Streamlining procurement timelines and reducing bureaucratic hurdles
Eliminating all private sector participation in defence manufacturing
Increasing collaboration between Indian defence firms and global OEMs
Promoting higher indigenisation requirements for defence contracts

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Eliminating all private sector participation in defence manufacturing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The updated **Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP) 2024** aims to strengthen India's self-reliance in defence manufacturing under the **'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' initiative.**
 
• The government is actively encouraging **private sector participation** in defence manufacturing to boost innovation, competition, and efficiency.
